resources.string: Your music, as a spinning record of dots. Add it to your home screen, or open the player and play with it: flick the record to skip, tap to pause, drag your finger through the dots.

Android only lets apps see what\'s playing through notification access. Dot Music uses it to read the song, cover and play state of your music app. It has no internet access, so nothing ever leaves your phone.
Three sizes. Tap one to drop it on your home screen. The equaliser, the orbiting comet and the ripples are played by your launcher itself, so they cost almost no battery.
Your launcher can\'t add widgets from an app. Long-press your home screen, choose Widgets, and find Dot Music.
Draw the cover in white dots, Nothing style, instead of its own colours.
The dot equaliser, orbiting comet and ripples on the widgets while music plays.

The player ripples and the ring moves with the actual music. Android files this under the microphone permission, but the app only measures how loud each frequency is and never records anything. Off: a steady pulse instead.
No internet permission. No accounts. Nothing is stored or sent anywhere.
The cover as a spinning record of dots, with play and pause.
Dot record, title in dots, live equaliser and controls.
A live dot equaliser, the title in dots, play and next.
Album cover in dots. Opens the player.
